strategies.name: Detection of Indicator Removal on Host

analytics.name: Analytic 1882
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies an audit log clearing event or deletion/truncation of an Industrial Control System (ICS) vendor application log file, immediately preceded by other suspicious activity on the same host within a short lookback window. Documented in the CaddyWiper deployment alongside Industroyer2, explicitly intended to destroy evidence and slow forensic recovery. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. Suppress vendor-signed software, approved engineering utilities, diagnostics, patching, backup, and documented maintenance.

tuning.description: Allowlist of processes/accounts authorized to delete or truncate ICS application logs.
Time window prior to a log-clear event within which other suspicious activity is considered correlated.
Documented schedule for legitimate, automated log rotation/archival.

log_sources.name: WinEventLog:Security
log_sources.channel: Windows Security Event ID 4688: EventCode=1102 correlated with any other Medium+ confidence alert on the same host within log clear lookback window
